question:
Identify the incorrectly spelt word and select its correct spelling.

The calandar was reformed during the time of Julius Caesar.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"calandar"** is incorrectly spelt and should be corrected to** "calendar"**. (कैलेंडर)

 
 
• **Example: **The calandar was reformed during the time of Julius Caesar.
 
 
 
• **"Calendar" **is a system by which the beginning, length, and divisions of a year are fixed. (कैलेंडर)
 
 
• **Example: **The **calendar** shows all the important holidays and events for the year.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **calendar**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **reeformed **(पुनः सुधारना): This is an incorrect spelling of "reformed".

 
 
• **Example:** The correct spelling is "reformed", which means to make changes in something in order to improve it.
 
 
 
• **celender **(ग़लत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "calendar".
 
 
• **Example: **He marked his birthday on the calendar.
 
 
 
• **riformed** (ग़लत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "reformed".
 
 
• **Example:** The school curriculum was reformed to include more practical subjects.
